risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Business depends on availability/supply and cost of raw materials sourced from domestic suppliers; a significant price increase or supply decrease could adversely affect results of operations.
- Business is subject to regulation by several authorities, which could have an adverse effect on business and results of operations.
- The Company is heavily dependent on its Promoters, and loss of their guidance and services may adversely affect business or results of operations.
- Changes in Tax laws in India (GST and Income Tax) may increase tax liabilities and inversely affect PAT.
- A slowdown in the Indian or global economy may adversely affect profit.
- Unfavourable tariffs may reduce the competitiveness of Indian textiles.
- Renewable energy projects carry risk of property damage/liability during construction, developer viability (key personnel, financial solidity, technical execution ability), environmental damage liability, insufficient access to investment/operating capital, cost increases in key inputs (labour, modules) or rate decreases for electricity generated, unscheduled plant closure, reduction in sale price, lower-than-expected generation, adverse policy changes (tax credits, RPS targets, permitting/interconnection), generation loss from lack of sunshine or panel soiling, and sabotage/terrorism/theft.
- Conflicts, shipping-route disruptions, container shortages, port congestion and freight-rate changes may increase costs and affect delivery schedules; export operations are also exposed to sanctions, payment-channel and country-specific trade restrictions.
